name: Jashore
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The official Jessore Zonal Settlement Office publishes Khatian and Mouza-map services; the Ministry of Land Records and Surveys portal offers map display and Khatian search, and states that it displays ongoing survey-stage records. The official district service catalogue describes certified Khatian and Mouza-map copies as application/fee-based. This confirms local survey/record services, not open full feature geometry.
remainingUncertainty: Whether a completed city Mouza dataset exists outside the ongoing survey viewer; which Mouza covers the WUP point; whether certified-map ordering is the only public map route; full geometry schema.
scopeLimits: The WUP locator is a settlement centroid, not a parcel identity. No citywide completeness is asserted. No owner/address/account/token values retained. At most three complete native parcel geometries may be retained for this city; none was obtained.
